description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed 
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers
Holding priority, activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Orzhov Basilica's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
